# DRA-47: the Plane of Sky checklist row ids, as SkyQuestDefaults.cs carried them the day it
# retired into GuideCatalog.json. Every player's Sky tick is stored under one of these ids (per
# character, in the quest ledger), so an id is a persisted KEY: it may never be renumbered or
# point at a different piece. SkyChecklistRowsTests holds the shipped guides to this list.
# A NEW row appends a line here in the same PR. An existing line's ID never changes; its reward
# text changes only together with a row in AppSettings.SkyRewardRenames (or the turn-in is lost).
